name: Paperless-ngx
description: Recent scans, full-text search, tag/correspondent filtering for a self-hosted Paperless-ngx instance. Credentials stay in encrypted device storage.
author: iappyx
aiPrompt: iappyx.plugin('paperless-ngx') talks to a self-hosted Paperless-ngx instance (user configures URL + API token via Settings → Plugins → Paperless-ngx → Configure). All methods return Promises with {ok, ...} or {ok:false, error}. Surface: isConfigured() → {ok, configured}. ping() → {ok, version}. recent({count:20}) → {ok, documents:[{id, title, created, addedAt, correspondentId, documentTypeId, tagIds, pageCount, fileName}]} newest first. search({query, count}) → {ok, documents:[...]} full-text search across content + title + correspondent. byTag({tagId, count}) → {ok, documents:[...]} filtered by a single tag id. tags() → {ok, tags:[{id, name, color, isInboxTag}]} — call this first to discover the inbox tag id, then byTag({tagId:<inboxId>}) shows unprocessed scans. correspondents() → {ok, correspondents:[{id, name, documentCount}]}. document({id}) → {ok, document:{...all fields including full OCR content}}. thumbnail({id}) → {ok, dataUrl:'data:image/webp;base64,...'} small preview image. download({id}) → {ok, dataUrl:'data:application/pdf;base64,...'} full file. Best for widgets: 'inbox count' (byTag with isInboxTag), 'last 5 receipts' (byTag with a 'receipt' tag), 'tap to copy invoice number' (regex on document.content), 'monthly expense total' (sum amounts from tagged invoices).
